subject: envir argument in knit_child doesn't work ?

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: envir argument in knit_child doesn't work ?
parts:
Hello, 

 I have such a function:

knitDataSummary <- function(dat){
  # defines a new environment to store the dataframe:
  myenv <- new.env()
  assign("dat", dat, envir=myenv)
  # knit: 
  output <- knit_child(file.path(system.file(package = "mypackage"), "knitr", "child_DataSummary.Rmd"), envir=myenv)
  return(output)
}


The child template child_DataSummary.Rmd performs a summary table of the dat dataframe.  Then in my main Rmd file I call this function like this:

`r knitDataSummary(mydata)`

but the dat object is not found, as if the envir argument were not taken into account (otherwise the child template is well knitted).
